New Holland unveils new Workmaster models, AI camera for real-time forage monitoring

Farm Progress Show: The new tractor models offer power, lift capacity and versatility, a New Holland product specialist said. They also come in a new color.

Andy Castillo,Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery,Farm ProgressSeptember 3, 2026

schedule2 Min Read

New Holland’s Workmaster compact utility tractor was on display at the Farm Progress Show, featuring the brand’s new “dynamic blue” paint color. Andy Castillo

Subscribe to Farm Progress AGTech — our free, twice-weekly newsletter delivering the latest innovations, emerging technologies and expert insights to your inbox.

New Holland announced a number of new products at this year’s Farm Progress Show, including three new models in its Workmaster compact utility tractor lineup — the 45C, 50C and 55C, ranging from 47 to 57 hp.

“Compact tractor customers are asking more from a single machine than ever before,” said Cory Hunt, compact tractor product specialist for New Holland North America. The new tractors are “designed for customers who need more power, more lift capacity and more versatility without stepping into a traditional utility tractor. We call this range of Workmasters ‘compact utility’ because they give owners the power and confidence to take on bigger jobs while not losing sight of the size or simplicity of the tractors.”

Alongside those new utility workhorses, New Holland debuted ForageCam harvester technology for its FR Forage Cruiser models that can provide real-time kernel processing monitoring.

Related:Farm Progress Show 2026: What you need to know

A camera powered by artificial intelligence analyzes chopped corn as it flows through the spout, calculating the percentage of fully processed kernels and comparing it against the target processing levels that have been predetermined by the operator in real time.

This data is used to continuously and automatically adjust the kernel processor to achieve the desired forage quality, eliminate underprocessing, boost productivity, minimize fuel consumption and reduce machine wear.

“For dairy and beef producers, feed quality is the most important indicator of forage harvester performance,” said Patrick Weitzel, forage harvester marketing manager for New Holland North America. “Producers and custom operators are getting a real-time [kernel processing score] and can assess right away if the quality is high enough the moment their forage is running through the harvester. In the past, we had to guess from the cab what the score was or send samples to the lab to determine the KPS. Now, we instantly know the forage score and quality.”

Besides those new products, New Holland debuted a new paint color on its Workmaster, T7, XD and new PowerStar machines displayed at the Farm Progress Show called “dynamic blue.” The refreshed paint is slightly bluer than its former look. Check out the new look at this year’s Farm Progress Show, running through Thursday.

About the Author

Andy Castillo

Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery, Farm Progress

Andy Castillo started his career in journalism about a decade ago as a television news cameraperson and producer before transitioning to a regional newspaper covering western Massachusetts, where he wrote about local farming. Between military deployments with the Air Force and covering the news, he earned an MFA in creative nonfiction writing from Bay Path University, building on the English degree he earned from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. In his role at Farm Progress, Castillo covers agricultural technology, new machinery and the constantly evolving farm equipment marketplace.

Castillo splits his time between the open road and western Massachusetts with his wife, Brianna, a travel nurse who specializes in pediatric oncology, and their rescue pup, Rio. When not attending farm shows, Castillo enjoys playing music, snowboarding, writing, cooking and restoring their 1920 craftsman bungalow. You can find Castillo at farm machinery shows across the country.

translationZh:
纽荷兰在今年的农场进步展上发布了一系列新产品，包括其Workmaster紧凑型多功能拖拉机系列中的三款新机型——45C、50C和55C，功率范围从47到57马力。

“紧凑型拖拉机客户对单台机器的要求比以往任何时候都要高，”纽荷兰北美紧凑型拖拉机产品专家科里·亨特表示。新拖拉机“专为那些需要更大动力、更高提升能力和更强多功能性，但又不想升级到传统多功能拖拉机的客户而设计。我们将这一系列Workmaster称为‘紧凑型多功能’，因为它们在赋予车主承担更大作业任务的动力和信心的同时，也没有忽视拖拉机的尺寸和简洁性。”

在这些新型多功能主力机型之外，纽荷兰还为其FR Forage Cruiser系列推出了ForageCam收割机技术，该技术可提供实时的籽粒破碎监测。

**AI摄像头实时分析**

一个由人工智能驱动的摄像头在切碎的玉米流经抛送筒时对其进行分析，计算完全破碎籽粒的百分比，并与操作员预先设定的目标破碎水平进行实时比对。

该数据用于持续自动调节籽粒处理器，以达到理想的饲料品质，消除处理不足的情况，提高生产率，最大限度地减少燃油消耗并降低机器磨损。

“对于奶牛和肉牛养殖户来说，饲料品质是衡量青贮收获机性能的最重要指标，”纽荷兰北美青贮收获机市场经理帕特里克·韦策尔表示。“养殖户和定制服务商现在能获得实时的籽粒破碎评分，并在饲料通过收获机的瞬间立即评估其品质是否足够高。过去，我们只能在驾驶室里猜测评分，或者将样品送到实验室测定KPS。现在，我们可以即时了解饲料评分和品质。”

除了这些新产品，纽荷兰还在农场进步展上展出的Workmaster、T7、XD和新款PowerStar机型上首次推出了名为“动态蓝”的新涂装。这种焕新的油漆颜色比之前的颜色更偏蓝一些。
